text: APPROVE. The patch moves the inner loop body into a static helper, `AddGoEmbedRef`, with each `continue` becoming an equivalent `return`. That removes the nested ifs, the `||` conditions and the ternaries from `CollectGoEmbedRefs`, which should bring its complexity well under 15. Behaviour is unchanged, and the helper takes only the values the original body used, so it should build cleanly. I could not confirm the declared type of `hostEmbeds`, so I'm assuming it is `List<HostEmbedRef>`, as the helper's signature expects.
